maria (partnerships): Quick win — SaffronAI is live on Oracle Cloud Marketplace as an ISV listing! :tada: Private listing + dedicated onboarding included, plus a short-term pilot committing 100k tokens/month.
devin (sales): Amazing — congrats team. Who owns the case study? We should lock this into a quarter PR win.
ajay (solutions): I’ll take the technical case study draft. Need a week to pull architecture diagrams and perf numbers for the Dedicated flow.
lisa (customer-success): I’ll schedule the kickoff with Saffron tomorrow. Need the SSO integration notes and customer contacts.
ben (marketing): Heads-up — I’ll prepare a 1-pager + blog draft. Can someone send me a short quote from the Saffron PM? Also want screenshots of the console flow.
hallie (legal): Contract addendum for marketplace listing is signed. There’s one small data residency note for their EU tenants — CS and Solutions should flag with the customer.
marketplace-bot: Listing verification completed — manifest.json OK, entitlement checks passed.
maria (partnerships): Next steps: (1) Ajay to handover case study draft to Ben by next Tue; (2) Lisa to run kickoff + checklist (SSO, VCN, billing) and confirm EU residency plan; (3) Marketing to aim for announcement week after pilot kickoff. 
devin (sales): I’ll update the CRM and add renewal milestone at month 10. Also looping in AM.
ajay (solutions): Sharing preliminary perf numbers here in thread in a bit — seeing 28% lower p95 with our batching profile on Dedicated for their workload.
lisa (customer-success): Adding Saffron contacts: priya@saffron.ai and marc@saffron.ai. Will propose Wed 11am PT for kickoff.
ben (marketing): If Saffron can provide a quote, I’ll try to get the blog out within 2 weeks. Congrats everyone! :clap:
hallie (legal): Noted on EU tenancy — Lisa pls capture as an open item.
maria (partnerships): Huge team effort — thanks. Tagging @ajay @lisa @ben to keep momentum. :rocket:
